entities.summary: Per Edgar Ragnar "Ragge" Wicksell was a Swedish football and bandy player. He competed in the 1912 Summer Olympics and in the 1920 Summer Olympics. In 1912, he played as midfielder one match in the main tournament as well as one match in the consolation tournament.
